title: RT-safety grep-gate script (forbidden processBlock calls, ScopedNoDenormals present)
description:
Add a CI-runnable RT-safety static grep gate per Build Spec §14 item 1. Wave-1 independent task; scripts only.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock region (ScopedNoDenormals, engine call path)
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §7 (processBlock contract) and §14 item 1
- scripts/build_all.sh from phase A (how cmake is located; cmake is NOT on PATH — CLion-bundled via build_all.sh)
- Sibling gate scripts under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/ if any

Implement scripts/check_rt_safety.sh:
1. Bash script, set -euo pipefail, runnable from repo root: `bash scripts/check_rt_safety.sh`.
2. Fail (non-zero) if processBlock-related sources reference forbidden APIs in audio-thread code paths, at minimum grepping Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (and optionally Source/DSP/** process paths) for: `\bnew\b`, `malloc`, `juce::String`, and lock primitives (`lock`, `CriticalSection`, `std::mutex`, `scoped_lock`) used inside processBlock or clearly audio push paths. Prefer scoped checks (processBlock function body / MeterTap push) to avoid false positives on prepareToPlay; document the strategy in script comments.
3. Assert `ScopedNoDenormals` is present in Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock path; fail if missing.
4. Print clear PASS/FAIL lines on stdout; exit 0 only on full pass.
5. Do not require cmake on PATH; this gate is pure source grep (no configure/build). May call `rg` or `grep -E`.
6. Make the script executable bit in content via shebang; chmod is fine if the environment allows.

Do not edit CMakeLists, C++ sources, presets, or docs.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/check_rt_safety.sh exists and is a bash script with a shebang
scripts/check_rt_safety.sh fails when processBlock sources contain forbidden patterns among new, malloc, juce::String, or lock primitives (as implemented)
scripts/check_rt_safety.sh asserts ScopedNoDenormals is present in Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
scripts/check_rt_safety.sh exits 0 only on pass and prints PASS/FAIL diagnostics
Script does not assume cmake is on PATH
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: hard-code machine-specific absolute paths unrelated to repo-relative lookup

allowed: limit scan to processBlock body and MeterTap push TO reduce false positives
optional allowlist comments for known false positives
forbidden: edit C++ to silence the gate
own pluginval script or CMakeLists wiring
full dynamic allocator-hook sanitizer harness in this task (static grep only)
